fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Mark the rear gate location with a reflective indicator so responders can locate it quickly from the front of the property.
• Keep the rear gate unlocked or secured with a breakaway lock to allow responders to reach the detached structure without delay.
• Trim vegetation along the walkway and fence line to keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Clear a direct walking path between the vehicle parking area and both structures so responders can move equipment without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the rear and sides of the property to allow responders to move around the perimeter on foot.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency apparatus to pull forward and turn around.
• Post a simple site diagram near the front entry or driveway showing the location of both structures and the rear gate.

wildfire.conditions: Large Trees; Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Vegetation Near Structure; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that hang directly over or close to the roofline and eaves.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to the structure's exterior walls.
• Keep the area beneath large trees clear of dead leaves, fallen branches, and accumulated debris.
• Separate shrubs from nearby trees so fire cannot move easily from low plants up into the tree canopy.
• Maintain the open terrain around the structure by keeping it free of debris piles, cut wood, and dead plant material.
• Keep all access routes clear of low-hanging branches so vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Remove dead wood and dry debris from within the scattered tree areas closest to the structure.
